title: Wide Putin (Song for Denise)
blurb: The Wide Putin theme — 'Song for Denise', forever fused to footage of a horizontally-stretched world leader strutting down a Kremlin hallway. The synth groove turned a video-compression accident into one of history's great absurdist memes. Play it for any confident walk, ideally with the walker stretched to 4:3. He approaches. He is wide.
origin: 'Song for Denise' by Piano Fantasia, soundtrack of the Wide Putin walking meme.
